definition: a container you put rubbish in
description: A woman with a microphone commentates like a sports announcer while a man shoots crumpled paper balls at a mini basketball hoop mounted above a teal trash can. He celebrates a made shot, then picks up the missed paper balls off the floor and drops them into the open can.
transcript: (upbeat music) - For the win. - Switch! (upbeat music)

en.question: Where is the man putting the paper?

de.answer: Er legt es in den Mülleimer.
de.question: Wohin legt der Mann das Papier?

es.answer: Lo está poniendo en la papelera.
es.question: ¿Dónde está poniendo el papel el hombre?

fr.answer: Il le met dans la poubelle.
